outputComponents.text:
I have designed and built the **GeoLens — Sources & Citations** desktop product screen within the AI Visibility suite, adhering strictly to your color system, brand rules, and B2B SaaS interface guidelines.

### What Was Designed & Implemented:

1. **Brand Identity & Strict Color System:**
   - **Primary Accent:** Teal (`#0F766E`) exclusively applied for primary actions, active state indicators, and benchmark highlights. No purple or unwanted tones.
   - **Neutrals:** Crisp white surfaces (`#FFFFFF`), light platform background (`#F5F7F8`), ink dark text (`#0B1218`), muted metadata text (`#5C6B76`), and borders (`#E3E9ED`).
   - **Typography:** **Plus Jakarta Sans** with clean B2B hierarchy and strict standard icon glyphs (no emojis).

2. **Persistent App Chrome:**
   - **Left Navigation:** Fully synchronized with the GeoLens suite structure. **Sources & Citations** is active under the *Boost & Monitor* section with teal pill styling and live indicator.
   - **Top Bar:** Project switcher displaying `Attio · Demo`, `Last 7 days` (active) / `Last 30 days` / `90 days`, `All Models (4)`, `Export`, and the prominent teal `New Analysis` button.

3. **Core Sources & Citations Workspace:**
   - **Header & Subtitle:** *"Sources & Citations: Domains AI retrieves and cites when answering buyer questions"*.
   - **4 KPI Metric Cards:**
     - **Domains Retrieved:** `418` (+34 trend, 2,840 queries in crawl surface).
     - **Citation Rate:** `38.2%` (+4.1%, top decile across 4 foundation engines).
     - **Own-Domain Share:** `21.4%` (182 direct citations for `attio.com`).
     - **Gap Domains:** `64` (with 18 flagged as critical rival-dominated domains).

4. **Telemetry & Citation Data Table:**
   - **Filters:** Domain search bar, segment filters (`All`, `Own`, `Competitor`, `Other`), and `Cited only (exclude unverified retrievals)` toggle.
   - **Columns:** `Domain` (with favicon monogram & sub-paths), `Retrieved %` (with progress visualization), `Citation Rate`, `Classification` badge, `Mentions`, and `Gap vs You` (showing positive baseline/leads vs gaps).
   - Real benchmark records for `attio.com` (Own), `hubspot.com`, `salesforce.com`, `g2.com` (Review Platform), `reddit.com` (Community), `techcrunch.com` (Media), and `pipedrive.com`.

5. **Right-Hand Intelligence Rail:**
   - **Top Cited Domains:** Visual horizontal bar chart ranking the top 5 citation leaders across 2,840 AI answer generations.
   - **Domain Classification Card & CTA:** Classification completion bar (91.8% categorized) with the primary button **"Classify Domains"** to tag unclassified sources.
   - **Engine Retrieval Breakdown:** Citation density comparison across Perplexity Pro, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT-4o, and Gemini.
